why: arXiv:2411.16146 (Nov 2024), 'On the divisorial contractions to curves of threefolds', proves that each terminal divisorial contraction to a curve is a weighted blow-up and, as a corollary, obtains a Du Val elephant, proving the general elephant conjecture for this class of extremal contractions.
